archimate:Outcome.name: Seamless Access to Patient Information Across Care Settings
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
The "Seamless Access to Patient Information Across Care Settings" goal is an interoperability objective focused on ensuring that authorized healthcare providers can instantly retrieve and view a patient's complete, up-to-date medical history regardless of where the data was originally recorded.
Its purpose is to eliminate information blind spots during clinical encounters, enabling faster, safer decision-making by placing essential patient data at the fingertips of care teams in real time.
Example: A regional health network achieves this goal by implementing a unified exchange protocol that allows a treating emergency room physician to instantly review a visiting patient’s allergy list and active prescriptions documented by their out-of-state primary care doctor.
